mapper.select: SELECT a.id FROM tradingsystem.accounts a WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tradingsystem.users u WHERE u.account_id = a.id ) ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 1
SELECT id, account_id, username, first_name, last_name, email, phone_no, roles, created_on FROM tradingsystem.users WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, account_id, username, first_name, last_name, email, phone_no, roles, created_on FROM tradingsystem.users WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, account_id, username, first_name, last_name, email, phone_no, roles, created_on FROM tradingsystem.users WHERE account_id = #{accountId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tradingsystem.users ( username, account_id, roles, created_on ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{accountId}, #{roles}::TEXT[], NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tradingsystem.users SET first_name = #{firstName}, last_name = #{lastName}, email = #{email}, phone_no = #{phoneNo}, created_on = created_on WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM authentication.credentials c WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tradingsystem.users u WHERE u.account_id = c.account_id )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM authentication.credentials c WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tradingsystem.users u WHERE u.account_id = c.account_id )
